checks.name: Unattended tab: exports can stall (environmental throttling, not a data defect)
checks.detail: When no tool call was driving the Chrome tab during an export, the job stayed "running": a 1 s job stuck at progress fraction 0.9437699999969918 for 30 s, then cancelExport returned state cancelled but the page kept refusing new exports ("A visual export is already active") until a later tool call in the tab woke it; another 1 s job and a first-attempt 2 s job stayed running for 60 s and were ended by releaseExport ("Playback stopped."). document.visibilityState reported "visible" throughout. Every export completed when a concurrent tool call kept requestAnimationFrame running in the tab. Some unattended jobs also completed normally (a 1 s job in 3.4 s and 2 s jobs).

observations: Artifact bytes are not committed to the repository; only sizes and hashes are recorded.
State "running" with progress below 1 for tens of seconds in an undriven tab is a tab-throttling symptom; cancelExport does not take effect in the page until the tab runs again.
